findings.title: Stale writes: validate live client authority before every thread mutation
findings.detail: Reply-only operations skip the live-head check entirely. If another push changes the PR after round approval, an otherwise valid saved state still permits reply, contrary to the shared contract that an unexpected remote head invalidates authority. Resolution paths also read only headRefOid, so a PR closed without changing its head still passes. Check the live head and OPEN state for every client mutation, retaining the additional fix-ancestry requirement for resolution.
findings.evidence: main maps reply to process-review, whose gate compares cached snapshot fields with cached clientRound fields. require_client_fix returns immediately for reply; do_reply then calls send_reply. For resolve and reply-and-resolve, the fresh gh pr view at line 901 requests only headRefOid. repository-policy.md:90-93 invalidates authority on unexpected remote heads, and watch-policy.jq:162 requires an OPEN snapshot.

findings.title: Tests that cannot fail: isolate the head-mismatch rejection
findings.detail: The head-mismatch testcase omits snapshot.state and reviewId. It therefore remains successful if the snapshot-head comparison is removed, because the OPEN-state and authorized-review checks independently reject it. Supply OPEN and an authorized reviewId so the head mismatch is the sole invalid field.
findings.evidence: checked_state rejects snapshot.state != OPEN or a reviewId absent from clientRound.reviewIds in the same condition as the head comparison. Both unrelated failures occur in this input, and the test asserts only exit code 5. The moved-head fixture tests the separate live-head check, so it does not cover removal of the snapshot-head comparison.

findings.title: Uncited: Read resolution metadata in one projection
findings.detail: Angle: Efficiency. Each client resolution launches three consecutive jq processes to read repository, PR number and head from the same validated state file. Combining these projections removes two process launches and two file parses per resolution. Disposition: skipped because this review is report-only.
findings.fix: Extract the three fields with one checked jq invocation, then unpack them using a delimiter excluded by their validated formats. Preserve the surrounding reason, fix-ancestry and remote-head checks.

findings.title: Uncited: Centralize repeated fixture state rewrites
findings.detail: Angles: Reuse and Altitude. Six branches repeat the same jq-to-next-file and rename sequence. Maintaining that transport requires coordinating six copies and obscures each branch's actual policy change. Disposition: skipped because this review is report-only.
findings.fix: Use one fixture-local function accepting jq arguments to transform raw through next and rename it after success. Keep mode-specific filters, operation order and failure propagation unchanged.
